persona: On-premises Exchange administrator moving to Microsoft 365
resumeText:

IT Support Engineer, Charminar Systems, Hyderabad (2018 - 2020)
- Set up Outlook profiles and Teams for users.

Exchange, Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, Intune, PowerShell
